items.title: Thinking Fast, Trading Late: System One Decision Models vs the Market
items.claim: Commercial LLM news signals predict overnight moves but not post-open returns.

items.title: Beyond Anonymous Order Flow: Wallet Identity as a Feature for Short-Horizon Return Prediction
items.claim: Wallet identity features raise one-second out-of-sample R2 from 10.88% to above 12%.

items.title: Right Model, Wrong Answer: How Missing User Context Silently Flips AI Financial Advice
items.claim: Omitting one user fact makes frontier AI financial advice confidently wrong 33 of 33 times.

items.title: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation
items.claim: Fine-tuned small decision models show no edge beyond prior base rates on reality-labeled finance questions.

items.title: LENS: Reliability-Aware Stock Prediction via LLM-Extracted Priors and News-Driven Semantic Graphs
items.claim: Reliability-weighted LLM graphs and news semantics lift S&P 500 top-five ranking 16-23%.

items.title: LLM-Generated Investment Research Memos Need Validation
items.claim: One-to-two percent claim refutation still leaves 37-41% of LLM memos containing a false claim.
